claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Efest IMR 18500 1000mAh 15A as a 1000mAh preset with a 15A runtime rating.
The tested 2016 Efest IMR 18500 1000mAh revision has a purple wrapper, flat-top terminal, no protection circuit, and observed dimensions of approximately 18.39 mm x 49.79 mm.

The Efest IMR 18500 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Efest IMR 18500 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2016-05-14 or earlier.
